consumers: any sovereign settlement with an exact office epoch
constitutionalBasis: The Academy is repeatedly contracted because each receiver can independently derive the same missing service from its own office and incumbency state. Its Union-wide standing is glued from these local derivations; it is not delegated a global personnel power.

premises: the receiver owns an exact office epoch with duties and skill requirements
the receiver's current incumbency census lacks a receiver-recognized and receiver-induced character qualified for that exact epoch
localDerivation.conclusion: the receiver needs a character-formation or character-supply service and offers a provider-neutral lot to an admitted market
localDerivation.author: receiver-only

contractingTopology: Leader Movement Team contracts Board of Directors for the Leader's governance outcome
Board of Directors contracts its Executive Office for constitutionally delegated executive realization
Executive Office contracts operating enterprises for their distinct outcomes
each operating receiver tenders its locally derived officer-supply outcome; Union Officer Academy may bid and becomes provider only after receiver-local award and contract admission
nonExclusivity: The topology describes responsibility and procurement, not a mandatory message gateway; sovereign settlements retain direct bilateral boundary faces.
prohibitions: no provider-authored Offer counts as receiver-local derivation or acceptance
no upstream enterprise speaks a downstream receiver's local necessity
no local derivation preselects the Academy or any provider
no Academy demand cover, bid, or award appoints, recognizes, induces, grants, or writes a receiver's plate
no count of apparent vacancies is represented as mutually accepted demand
